calls.statement:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nostaff, count(*) n
  FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.refunds,0) net_sales, s.nostaff - coalesce(r.refunds,0) net_nostaff, s.n FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r USING(store_id) WHERE s.store_id < 900 OR s.store_id IS NULL)
SELECT store_id, round(net_sales,2) ns, rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) rk, rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_nostaff DESC) rk_nostaff FROM x ORDER BY rk

UNION ALL
SELECT 'P2 first 14 days', sum(net_sales), count(*), sum(net_sales)/count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=125 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2),
sales AS (SELECT f.store_key, sum(f.net_amount) amt FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (SELECT r.store_key, sum(r.refund_net) amt FROM fact_return_line r, p WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
st AS (SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, coalesce(sum(s.amt),0) - coalesce(sum(r.amt),0) net_sales FROM dim_store st LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.store_key = st.store_key LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.store_key = st.store_key WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING coalesce(sum(s.amt),0) <> 0)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, store_id, store_name, 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, round(net_sales,2) AS net_sales FROM st ORDER BY sales_rank
